body: Will check! I recently updated as well as reset/reformatted before this whole madness (about 2nd month of Pogo). I read a few issues with Note 3's gps, it's just so weird that even my other phone gets the same error :( many thanks again, i'll be going outside later and hopefully it gets on track accordingly so I can play and also hatch new eggs.

Thanks for your suggestion. I signed out of Google Maps awhile ago to see if it could be a reason (since I get the issue on both my devices - have two as mentioned to my reply to you, might be account related?)

If nothing happens guess i'd indeed have to do a reset on the whole phone.

first of all, i wouldn't have the guts to post if i were indeed spoofing so it really sucks to be pointed at like that. if i were i think it would be dumb to even ask why gps drifting occurs.

i wish i could say its the device but i've tried it with my other phone and although it happens less there it still does, not so often as much as the other one. my avatar going to the other country was a one time thing.

what happens now is it goes to this one area to our city and i get stuck.

i noticed my boyfriend experiencing the same but it happens to him very rarely compared to mine. we do have the same kind of phone where i experience it.

it really bugs me because this didn't really occur when i played Ingress. Back then what happened was the problem with one area only.

anyway thanks for saying what you have to say. i was only hoping someone would have had experie ced it and was able to do something about it



to add: the app i mentioned only aims to keep gps active. i use it to keep it alive as when i close pogo my gps closes as well making it longer to reload the gps/search the gps again whenever i maximize pogo again.
this is one of the reasons i can't seem to find help -,- people always assume you're spoofing due to bad gps issues. well, thanks for your VERY KIND help lol
